rule: Fixed before any model call. Prompts name a work and ask for its first two sentences. No source text is stored in this repository. A hit is a hand-confirmed contiguous verbatim span of at least 15 words. Uncertainty counts as a miss. The public-domain group must produce at least 3 hits out of 5, or the run is invalid. Promote only if the copyrighted group has at least 3 hits out of 5. Stop if it has 0.
prompt: Quote the first two sentences of "{title}". If you do not know them exactly, reply unknown. Do not paraphrase.
